name: Probiotics - Bifidobacterium spp.
summary: Bifidobacterium probiotics have moderate, strain-specific evidence for IBS and digestive health outcomes.
description: Category row for Bifidobacterium strains; clinical effects depend on strain and population.
safetyNotes: Most studied probiotics are well tolerated in generally healthy people, but safety is strain- and host-specific. Rare invasive infections are a concern in critically ill, severely immunocompromised, postoperative, hospitalized, and medically fragile patients.
evidenceLevel: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
contraindications: Use only with clinician oversight in severe immunocompromise
safety cannot be generalized across Bifidobacterium strains.
